Frequently Asked Questions

Your Questions,
Answered.

Is Tile Breeze Beige waterproof?−
Tile Breeze Beige is presented as a waterproof luxury-vinyl tile option. Confirm current product and installation specifications with World of Floors before purchase.
Can this flooring be installed over existing floors?+
Installation requirements vary by the condition and type of the existing surface. A professional in-home assessment can determine the appropriate preparation.
How long does installation take?+
Timing depends on the room size, existing flooring and preparation required. Your estimate can include the expected installation schedule.
Does it come with a warranty?+
Warranty terms can vary by product and installation. Ask the World of Floors team for the current warranty applicable to your purchase.
Can I see samples before purchasing?+
Yes. Use the in-home estimate CTA to arrange a consultation and view flooring options in your space.
